text:
Thanks for asking, and I'm sorry again for the runaround. 🌿

**If your claim is approved, yes: you'd get the same plant again.** Under the Plant Care Guarantee, we send **one free replacement of the same plant**. If your bird of paradise is out of stock, you'd get store credit instead.

- **Your replacement has its own new 30-day guarantee** from delivery. If it fails, it can be replaced once more.
- **Approval is up to the Plant Care Specialist** after they review your photos, so I can't promise it. Losing almost half its leaves is the kind of significant decline the guarantee covers, though.
- **I can't give you a firm date for the replacement.** Once a claim is approved, I don't have a confirmed shipping timeframe to share. Live plants only ship Monday to Wednesday, so that affects when it would go out.

Your escalation to a Support Lead is in motion. To help them find your claim quickly, please send your order number (LF- followed by six digits) and the date you submitted the claim, if you remember it. You can reply here or email help@leafy.example, which is answered within 1 business day.

Thank you for your patience. Please reach out any time, and I hope your bird of paradise pulls through! 🌿
